source.label: IVZ 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: Further, MassMutual has made significant capital or seed investments in several of our products.

source.label: IVZ 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: In addition to our previously announced broader strategic product and distribution partnership with Barings (MassMutual's global asset management subsidiary), we also announced a new strategic partnership with LGT Capital Partners during the fourth quarter.

relations.text_en: Sold 60% of its interest in Invesco Asset Management (India) to combine with its domestic distribution network

source.label: IVZ 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: We also completed the sale of 60% of our interest in Invesco Asset Management (India) Private Limited to IndusInd International Holdings Limited to enhance the revenue generation of the business by combining our asset management expertise with their domestic distribution network.
